cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at a gestational age of 23 weeks or more between 1993 and 2012 at a single university teaching hospital
finding: A cesarean delivery rate of 20% may still confirm additional beneficial effect on major perinatal morbidities without a significant increase in the incidence of placenta accreta.
